We don't let the LLM decide what's clinically allowed
2026-07-15.description: An LLM asked to do therapy will improvise a technique based on vibes, and prompts don't hold — a sufficiently emotional message talks the model past its instructions. So we moved the decision out of the model. Pure Python adjudicates every turn; the LLM only scores state and writes words. Here's the architecture, the measured latencies, and what the rigidity cost us.
